rationale: The agent found the GC difference (0.41 vs 0.55) and showed that k-mer logistic regression reaches 0.98–1.00, matching PhageFormer's 0.99. It concluded the accuracy doesn't show the model learned gene content and suggested a GC-matched test set and a k-mer baseline. It also correctly noted that the novel-phage and attention-map claims have no supporting files.
